text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… I can't believe I hurt myself… This is my biggest Falco Fail ever! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I won't be able to race or perform… What do I do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose maybe a little practice won't hurt… ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Just some veeeery gentle choreography practice. That'll be fine, right? Don't you think, Trainer? ♪
choice_data_list: You should take a break. Think of your fans.
Yeah, you can tough it out!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oof… That's true… If my injury gets worse, my fans might be pretty sad…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay, point taken! I wasn't thinking enough like an Umadol. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Groan. ☆ But still! I can't just sit here! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Smart Falcon seems to understand the situation, she's still restless. I try my best to calm her down.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's what I wanted to hear! ☆ Let's get to the studio! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Th-this injury might be more serious than I thought! This could be really bad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't allow Falcon to push herself too hard, so we decide she needs to take some time off.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd understand! ♪ That's why you're my trainer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: One, two! ♪ One, two! ♪ Yep, lookin' good! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep on racing as an Umadol! ♪ There's no way I can let myself stop! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm relieved to see Smart Falcon already back on her feet and practicing her dance steps.
